status: Third draft for review (2026-10-11). 0.2.3-draft was written from the taxonomy in proposals/2026-10-10-trial-endpoint-atlas.md plus one added class (exercise_capacity, not yet confirmed by the maintainer). 0.3.0-draft adds nine classes and fixes over-matching rules after a first real run, from the analysis in proposals/2026-10-11-lexicon-0.3-proposal.md; it was developed on dev entries only and has not been checked against the frozen set. The added classes need a clinician reader before publication. Every rule carries examples that test_lexicon.py runs; they are made-up English or short generic phrases, not registry text.
versioning: A rule id names one rule and is never reused for another meaning. A rule whose pattern or suppression changes keeps its id and carries a 'changed' note naming the lexicon version and what changed; a rule that would move to another class is retired and a new id is added. New rules get new ids. Tags record the lexicon version and hash, so a rule id is read together with them.

fallback_restrictions.note: Added in 0.3.0-draft (second round). A measure that names an exacerbation without the CF or pulmonary context EXAC-01 needs is left unclassified on purpose. Its description may confirm the exacerbations class, but may not give another class: a description that lists other outcomes (quality of life, cultures) would otherwise decide the tag.

matching.note: Rules run on the outcome's measure first. Only when no class rule (or only a vague one) matches there are they run on its description; from the description only the earliest match is kept, it is marked from_description, generic safety wording (fallback_excluded_rules) never decides a class from there, and a fallback restriction limits the classes the description may give when the measure matches its pattern. The time frame is used for bucketing only. Patterns are Python regular expressions, case-insensitive unless case_sensitive is true. Before matching, every run of whitespace in the registry text (line breaks included) is collapsed to one space, and subscript digits and dash characters are folded one to one to ASCII digits and '-', so a pattern's single space matches a double space or a line break, and a negative such as 'non serious' cannot be dodged by spacing; each span is mapped back and is always an exact piece of the original text. A rule with suppressed_by_pattern is dropped when that pattern also matches the same field. A pattern is refused at load if it holds an inline (?x) flag, an escaped space, or a quantified group whose content is itself quantified.

classes.label: FEV1
classes.gloss: Forced expiratory volume in one second, named explicitly (FEV1, ppFEV1).

classes.label: Other spirometry
classes.gloss: Other spirometry, such as FVC, FEF25-75 or peak flow, or spirometry with no FEV1 named.

classes.label: Lung clearance index
classes.gloss: Lung clearance index or multiple-breath washout.

classes.label: Lung function, not specified
classes.gloss: Lung or pulmonary function named without saying which measure.

classes.label: Airway resistance, compliance and lung volumes
classes.gloss: Lung tests other than spirometry or washout: airway resistance or reactance (oscillometry, plethysmography), compliance, or lung volumes such as RV, FRC or TLC.
classes.added: Added in 0.3.0-draft (proposals/2026-10-11-lexicon-0.3-proposal.md). Needs a clinician reader before publication.

classes.label: Oxygen and carbon dioxide levels
classes.gloss: Oxygen saturation or blood-gas values, including exhaled and transcutaneous estimates, such as pulse oximetry or end-tidal carbon dioxide.
classes.note: Named explicitly, oxygen saturation or oximetry is tagged here even inside a safety outcome, which then also keeps its safety tag; only the bare word desaturation gives way to safety (OXY-03). Exercise-test gas exchange (oxygen uptake) is exercise capacity.
classes.added: Added in 0.3.0-draft (proposals/2026-10-11-lexicon-0.3-proposal.md). Needs a clinician reader before publication.

classes.label: Sweat chloride
classes.gloss: Chloride concentration in sweat (the sweat test).

classes.label: Nasal potential difference
classes.gloss: Nasal potential difference.

classes.label: Intestinal current measurement
classes.gloss: Intestinal current measurement, usually on rectal biopsies.

classes.label: Other CFTR biomarker
classes.gloss: Another direct measure of CFTR function or expression, such as organoid swelling.

classes.label: Pulmonary exacerbations
classes.gloss: Pulmonary exacerbations in CF, counted or timed by the study.
classes.note: Only with a CF or pulmonary context (pulmonary, respiratory, protocol-defined, CF exacerbation, or PEx). A bare 'exacerbations' and asthma, COPD or ABPA exacerbations are left unclassified. Watched by the non-CF negative control.

classes.label: Nutrition and growth
classes.gloss: Weight, height, BMI, body composition or another nutrition or growth measure.

classes.label: Bone mineral density
classes.gloss: Bone mineral density or content, usually measured by DXA (often as a z-score in children), or low bone density defined by it.
classes.added: Added in 0.3.0-draft (proposals/2026-10-11-lexicon-0.3-proposal.md). Needs a clinician reader before publication.

classes.label: Gastrointestinal and pancreatic
classes.gloss: Digestive or pancreatic measures, such as fat absorption, faecal elastase or abdominal symptoms.

classes.label: Glucose and CF-related diabetes
classes.gloss: Blood glucose, HbA1c, insulin or CF-related diabetes.

classes.label: Liver
classes.gloss: Liver disease measures, such as liver stiffness or steatosis (liver blood tests are safety).
classes.note: Liver disease measures. Liver blood tests (liver function tests, liver enzymes, ALT, AST, bilirubin) are safety (laboratory) only, unless liver-disease wording is also present. From 0.3.0-draft 'liver function' without the word tests is also safety (laboratory).

classes.label: Sinus and upper airway
classes.gloss: Sinus, nasal polyp or other upper-airway measures.

classes.label: CFQ-R
classes.gloss: The CFQ-R questionnaire or one of its domains.

classes.label: Other named instrument
classes.gloss: Another named questionnaire or diary completed by the participant.

classes.label: Patient-reported, instrument not named
classes.gloss: Quality of life or symptoms reported by the participant, with no instrument named.

classes.label: Imaging
classes.gloss: Imaging, such as chest CT, MRI, X-ray or ultrasound.
classes.note: DXA and DEXA are not tagged imaging: they measure body composition (nutrition_growth, through its own words) or bone density (no class; left unclassified).

classes.label: Microbiology
classes.gloss: Bacteria, fungi or other organisms in sputum or cultures, including eradication.
classes.note: 0.3.0-draft: an organism's name alone (MICRO-04) is dropped when the entry names any other class, since it then describes the population. Sputum amount and properties are their own class, so the label is now Microbiology (the id is unchanged).

classes.label: Mucociliary clearance
classes.gloss: How much of an inhaled radiolabelled aerosol the airways clear over time, at rest or with coughing (mucociliary or cough clearance).
classes.added: Added in 0.3.0-draft (proposals/2026-10-11-lexicon-0.3-proposal.md). Needs a clinician reader before publication.

classes.label: Sputum amount and properties
classes.gloss: How much sputum is expectorated (weight or volume) or its physical properties, such as viscoelasticity or percent solids. Not microbiology.
classes.added: Added in 0.3.0-draft (proposals/2026-10-11-lexicon-0.3-proposal.md). Needs a clinician reader before publication.

classes.label: Inflammation markers
classes.gloss: Inflammation markers such as neutrophil elastase, interleukins or CRP; exhaled nitric oxide is mainly a type-2 marker and usually low in CF.
classes.note: 0.3.0-draft: faecal calprotectin, an intestinal-inflammation marker, is tagged here only (no longer also gastrointestinal); exhaled nitric oxide (FeNO) is tagged here with the gloss's caveat, pending a clinician reader.

classes.label: Gene expression and methylation
classes.gloss: Gene expression (RNA, microRNA) or DNA methylation measured in a blood, cell or tissue sample, other than CFTR expression (a CFTR biomarker).
classes.added: Added in 0.3.0-draft (proposals/2026-10-11-lexicon-0.3-proposal.md). Needs a clinician reader before publication.

classes.label: Oxidative stress markers
classes.gloss: Markers of oxidative stress or redox balance, such as isoprostanes, nitrotyrosine or glutathione redox state.
classes.added: Added in 0.3.0-draft (proposals/2026-10-11-lexicon-0.3-proposal.md). Needs a clinician reader before publication.

classes.label: Healthcare use
classes.gloss: Hospital stays, antibiotic courses, clinic visits or costs.

classes.label: Survival and transplant
classes.gloss: Survival, death or lung transplantation as an outcome.

classes.label: Safety and tolerability
classes.gloss: Adverse events, laboratory safety tests, vital signs or how well a treatment is tolerated.

classes.label: Pharmacokinetics
classes.gloss: Drug levels in the body over time, such as Cmax, AUC or half-life.

classes.label: Feasibility and adherence
classes.gloss: Whether a study or treatment can be carried out: adherence, recruitment, retention.

classes.label: Exercise capacity
classes.gloss: Exercise capacity, such as the six-minute walk or peak oxygen uptake.
classes.added: Added 2026-10-10 after review; not in the design's taxonomy. The maintainer must confirm it before the frozen set is labelled.
classes.note: 0.3.0-draft: field tests such as the sit-to-stand, chair-stand and shuttle tests, and other exercise-test measures (ventilatory threshold, peak workload), are tagged here. The domain is kept where it was (a decision; see the proposal).

classes.label: Physical activity
classes.gloss: Everyday physical activity, such as steps or active minutes, measured by a wearable device or reported in an activity questionnaire.
classes.added: Added in 0.3.0-draft (proposals/2026-10-11-lexicon-0.3-proposal.md). Needs a clinician reader before publication.

classes.label: Muscle strength and endurance
classes.gloss: Strength or endurance of limb muscles (grip, dynamometry) or breathing muscles (maximal inspiratory or expiratory pressure).
classes.added: Added in 0.3.0-draft (proposals/2026-10-11-lexicon-0.3-proposal.md). Needs a clinician reader before publication.

classes.label: Other
classes.gloss: A measure that fits none of the classes above.
classes.assigned_by: a model tag with an exact quote, or a person; no rule assigns it

classes.label: No measure named
classes.gloss: No measure is named: no primary outcome, a placeholder, or only words such as efficacy.
classes.assigned_by: rules NS-00, NS-01 and NS-V1 only

rules.changed: 0.3.0-draft: the spelled-out ratio (forced expiratory volume in one second to or over forced vital capacity) no longer matches.

Added in 0.3.0-draft: forced expiratory volume at 0.5 or 0.75 seconds (used in infants; a decimal comma is allowed), FEV6, and the FEV1/VC (Tiffeneau) ratio. Never FEV1.

timeframe.note: The longest duration written in the time frame decides the bucket. A unit followed by several numbers is read whole: 'Weeks 4-24', 'Week 4, 8, 12, 16', 'Years 1 to 5', 'Days 1 through 29' and 'Weeks 2 and 6' give their largest number. A time frame with no number and unit, such as 'Baseline' or 'end of study', is unparseable; an empty one is not stated. Boundary choice: the written number decides, with no adjustment for how a study counts its first day, so 'Day 28' is 'over 1 day to 4 weeks' and 'Day 29' (often a four-week visit when day 1 is the first dose) is 'over 4 weeks to 6 months'.
